hooks.name: light-properties
hooks.description: On every agent save under packages/core/src/envelope/** or packages/core/src/locate/**, re-runs the light-speed property tests VOY-P-05..VOY-P-11 (envelope monotonicity, hop bound, triangle bound, determinism, impossible-candidate inertness, confidence monotonicity, no invented position). The physics is the product: a save that breaks a bound is refused immediately, not at the next full CI run (§14.3, §14.6 fact 2).
